password.description: Password protection. Send null to remove.

domain.description: Branded domain that already exists in the account.

expiry.description: Expiration date and time. Send null to remove.

clickLimit.description: Maximum number of clicks before the link expires. Send null to remove.

expirationRedirect.description: Redirect URL after expiration. Send null to remove.

note.description: Internal note. Send null to remove.

displayTitle.description: Dashboard-only title. Send null to remove.

geoTarget.description: Geo targeting rules. Send [] to clear all.

deviceTarget.description: Device targeting rules. Send [] to clear all.

languageTarget.description: Language targeting rules. Send [] to clear all.

abTesting.description: A/B testing variants. Send [] to clear all.

parameters.description: URL parameters. Send [] to clear all.

metaTitle.description: Meta title. Send null to remove.

metaDescription.description: Meta description. Send null to remove.

metaImage.description: Social share preview image URL. Send null to remove.

pixels.description: Pixel IDs or names. Send [] to remove all.

collections.description: Collection IDs or names. Send [] to remove from all collections.
